newsitem.title: CHINA: China Zhenhua Port Machinery prices B share offer.
newsitem.headline: China Zhenhua Port Machinery prices B share offer.

text.p: Shanghai Zhenhua Port Machinery Co Ltd said on Monday it had fixed the price of its 100 million B share offering at 3.59 yuan per share.
The shares would be offered from Tuesday to Thursday, a spokeswoman for one or the underwriting firms said.
The offer was payable at $0.433 per share, with net proceeds estimated at $40 million, a company statement said.
Cosco Pacific would subscribe to 16.5 million of the foreign currency B shares at the placement price, the statement said.
Zhenhua said earlier its B share offer would carry a price/earnings ratio of nine to 11 times based on forecast 1997 net profits of 117 million yuan under international accounting standards.
The international coordinator was ABN AMRO Rothschild, and the lead underwriter was China Securities Co, the statement said.
Proceeds would be used to expand the company's core business making port cargo handling equipment, the company has said.
